name: Every Achievement Can Be Earned, And Only By Doing What It Says
note: Written with the gate on 2026-10-08 (D11). Each mutation puts back one of the nine broken achievements found that day, or breaks a path the forty depend on. Survival rejoined the S+ and 3-/2-minute badges with BACKLOG D15 (same day): the two mutations that put Survival back into them are replaced by the ones from "Survival is graded on the time left again" on, which break the seconds-played path instead.

mutations.name: Logic Master asks for 150 again
mutations.why: No record reaches 150 — the score tops out at 137 — so the badge, once registered in Play Games, could never be earned there either.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: the Logic Score is not worked out for the check
mutations.why: Nothing passes ctx.iq; reading it alone is how the badge sat unreachable since the first commit.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: a duel won no longer checks the achievements
mutations.why: Nothing else passes isBattleWin; the duel badge goes back to unreachable.
mutations.expectFailure: a duel won must check the achievements

mutations.name: a killer win skips the achievements again
mutations.why: Killer and classic differ in the puzzle only (user, 2026-10-07); the killer badges and every count would stop at the classic record.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: the counts are the classic record alone
mutations.why: Wins of a killer player would not reach the win badges — 20 killer wins and 5 classic are 25 wins.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: the killer badges read the classic record
mutations.why: A classic Lv.3 would hand out the killer Lv.3 badge.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements are given for something that is not what they say

mutations.name: a missing notes count reads as zero again
mutations.why: Every Lv.3 win becomes a win without notes — the badge given for nothing.
mutations.expectFailure: a win that says nothing about notes must not count as one without them

mutations.name: an old save counts as known from the start
mutations.why: A game saved before the notes were counted could have had notes already; it must not earn "no notes".
mutations.find: return { notesPlaced: 0, fastEntryUsed: false, fromStart: false, rewardedCells };
mutations.replace: return { notesPlaced: 0, fastEntryUsed: false, fromStart: true, rewardedCells };
mutations.expectFailure: an old save's notes are unknown, not zero

mutations.name: note_master reads the one game's count again
mutations.why: The win's own count was never passed; 50 notes across games would never add up.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: notes placed are not added to the record
mutations.why: The count lives only for one game; the 50 across games never adds up.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: adding a note is not counted
mutations.why: The board's own note button would leave the count at zero.
mutations.expectFailure: adding a note must be counted

mutations.name: Fast Entry is not noted
mutations.why: The Fast Entry badge goes back to unreachable.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: the time left in Survival is not passed
mutations.why: The clutch badge goes back to unreachable — it read 0 as 99.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: the days in all are not counted
mutations.why: The day badges go unreachable — the wallet only kept the streak.
mutations.expectFailure: these achievements cannot be earned by doing what they say

mutations.name: app start does not check the achievements
mutations.why: The day and streak badges would wait for a win; a badge earned before it existed would wait too.
mutations.expectFailure: app start must claim the day

mutations.name: a practice solved is not recorded
mutations.why: The academy badges go unreachable.
mutations.expectFailure: a practice board solved must be recorded

mutations.name: a technique counts every time it is solved
mutations.why: Solving one board twice would count as two techniques.
mutations.expectFailure: the second does not count again

mutations.name: the days in all merge as this phone's
mutations.why: A phone change would take the day count back to what the new phone had.
mutations.expectFailure: the days in all must merge as the larger

mutations.name: the academy merges as this phone's alone
mutations.why: Techniques practised on the old phone would be lost.
mutations.expectFailure: a technique practised on either phone stays practised

mutations.name: the backup leaves the academy out
mutations.why: A restore could not bring the techniques back.
mutations.expectFailure: the backup must carry the academy

mutations.name: Survival is graded on the time left again
mutations.why: The pre-D15 rule: "limit − time left", which 7 s a cell shrinks — a Survival Lv.1 played at the classic B pace (240 s) grades S+ and hands out the S+ badge.
mutations.replace: const timeTaken = gameMode === 'timeLimit' ? Math.max(1, [0, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1080][level] - timerSeconds) : timerSeconds;
mutations.expectFailure: given for something that is not what they say

mutations.name: an unknown Survival time grades fast
mutations.why: A win that did not say how long it took would grade S+ and earn the speed badges for nothing.
mutations.expectFailure: without its seconds played must not grade S+

mutations.name: the win grades without the seconds played
mutations.why: Every Survival win would be "time unknown" — graded C, and a fast one could never earn S+ or the speed badges.
mutations.find: const grade = speedrunRankFor(level, gameMode, timerSeconds, variant, playedSeconds);
mutations.replace: const grade = speedrunRankFor(level, gameMode, timerSeconds, variant);
mutations.expectFailure: must earn S+ and both speed badges

mutations.name: the speed badges read Survival's clock
mutations.why: Finishing a Survival game with 2:50 left after five minutes would count as solving it in under three.
mutations.expectFailure: given for something that is not what they say

mutations.name: the timer does not count the seconds played
mutations.why: The seconds played would stay at 0 — every Survival win graded S+.
mutations.expectFailure: must count a second played

mutations.name: a new game carries the last game's seconds played
mutations.why: The next Survival game would start with the last one's time already on it and grade slower than it was played.
mutations.expectFailure: a new game must start with no seconds played

mutations.name: the win does not report the seconds played
mutations.why: The board path would leave every Survival win "time unknown" (C), whatever the gate passes by hand.
mutations.expectFailure: the win must report the seconds played

mutations.name: the victory screen grades Survival without the seconds played
mutations.why: The screen would show C for every Survival win while the badges were graded on the real time.
mutations.find: const rankInfo = speedrunRankFor(level, gameMode, actualSeconds, variant, playedSeconds);
mutations.replace: const rankInfo = speedrunRankFor(level, gameMode, actualSeconds, variant);
mutations.expectFailure: the victory screen must grade Survival on the seconds played

mutations.name: the shared line gives the clock
mutations.why: A Survival share would say "cleared in [03:37]" for the time that was LEFT.
mutations.expectFailure: the shared line says

mutations.name: the victory screen is not handed the seconds played
mutations.why: The modal grades with what it is given; without it every Survival win shows C.
mutations.expectFailure: the victory screen must be handed the seconds played

mutations.name: an achievement text gets a comma again
mutations.why: The import CSV has no quoting: a comma in a name or description splits the row and Play refuses the zip (found 2026-10-09 in six texts).
mutations.find: 'Clear a Lv.5 Expert puzzle — the hardest level'
mutations.replace: 'Clear a Lv.5 Expert puzzle, the hardest level'
mutations.expectFailure: Play Games would refuse the achievements as they stand

mutations.name: two achievements share a name in one language
mutations.why: Play matches translations and icons to an achievement by its name; two with one name cannot both be imported.
mutations.expectFailure: Play Games would refuse the achievements as they stand

mutations.name: two achievements swap their Play Games ids
mutations.why: First Step would unlock High Five in Play Games and the other way round — no error anywhere, just the wrong badge for every player.
mutations.expectFailure: an achievement would unlock a different Play Games achievement, or none

mutations.name: a sign-in no longer sends what was earned signed out
mutations.why: Everything unlocked before the first sign-in, offline or before the console had the achievements would stay on the phone for good.
mutations.expectFailure: a sign-in must send the achievements unlocked while signed out

mutations.name: the sync sends unknown keys too
mutations.why: An old saved key (streak_7) has no Play Games id; sending it is a wasted call that reports failure on every sign-in.
mutations.expectFailure: every unlocked achievement goes up, and only ones that exist

mutations.name: the achievements screen opens the leaderboard
mutations.why: The button says achievements; opening the Logic Score ranking instead is a button that lies.
mutations.expectFailure: the achievements screen must open Google's own achievements screen
